name: Echoes Of The City
detailed_description:
¿What do the shadows hide?

Echoes of the City is a narrative psychological horror experience that combines mystery, history, and exploration. Set in the iconic San Telmo neighborhood of Buenos Aires, the game immerses you in a unique atmosphere where historic architecture, tango music, and family secrets intertwine to tell a deep and disturbing story.

You play as Franco Díaz, a disillusioned young man who returns to the city to take care of his father's abandoned house, little imagining that this simple assignment will lead him to discover a dark family legacy linked to one of the darkest periods in Argentine history: the military dictatorship. As you explore the house and its surroundings, you'll discover forgotten objects, disturbing documents, and fragments of the past that will make you question what you know about your own family.

Gameplay

This game primarily features a first-person narrative experience involving exploration, conversations, and engaging gameplay elements.

Key Features

  • Immersive First-Person Exploration: Dive into an abandoned house filled with intricate details, interactive objects, and hidden clues that reveal a dark family legacy.

  • Oppressive Atmosphere and Ambient Sound: Experience a fusion of tango and rock, with sound effects and environmental audio that heighten the tension in every corner.

  • Flashbacks and Reality Distortion: Engage with environmental shifts that blur the line between memory and reality, enriching the narrative.

  • Engaging and Personal Storytelling: Follow Franco Díaz on his journey to confront the echoes of his past, uncovering family secrets in a setting of mystery and psychological horror.
